up: Retrieve compounds with IC50 activity values in nM against the target CHEMBL6136. Return the compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, PubMed ID or DOI (prefer PubMed ID, fallback to DOI), assay description, and target organism. Do not apply a row limit.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi, ass.description AS assay_description, td.organism AS target_organism FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL6136' AND a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND a.standard_units = 'nM' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
